explication: PGV is a protoc plugin that turns validation rules attached to protobuf fields into language-specific validators. The main workflow is proto constraints → plugin and rule checking → language templates → generated validation code. Java also provides a validator runtime and optional gRPC interceptors; Python instead generates and caches validation functions at runtime. The graph reflects documented capabilities, but several template and runtime implementations were not sampled, so their internal connections are limited to relationships shown in the README or source index.
